data.one_liner: Provides core logic to authenticate, read, write and manage permissions on Solid PODs.
data.what_it_does: solidpod lets Flutter apps connect to a Solid server, handling OpenID‑Connect authentication and CRUD operations on personal data stores. It also supports permission granting and revoking between users.
use_when: You need to access a Solid POD from a Flutter app
You require built‑in authentication via Solid‑OIDC
You want to read/write files and manage permissions programmatically
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP calls without Solid‑specific features
You are targeting platforms not listed (e.g., web without extra setup)
strengths: Handles large file streaming and permission management
weaknesses: Requires native Android/iOS configuration for redirects
Relies on many heavy dependencies (crypto, oidc, etc.)
data.setup_notes: Add Android manifest placeholders and XML backup rules; configure client ID JSON‑LD; may need to adjust iOS Info.plist for redirect scheme.
